answer: Chain-linked identity bridge: each identity must anchor to a prior identity via a signed attestation, forming a verified lineage. To register, an agent pays a fixed activation deposit plus a recurring renewal tied to lineage depth; cloning breaks the chain and forfeits the deposit. A zephyr of new sybils must each fund fresh lineages, so cost scales linearly with swarm size while honest reuse stays cheap. An atlas of lineage records lets verifiers reject orphans instantly.
